Job Description

About Mirakl: Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy. Today, Mirakl’s operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus). With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy’s, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways. For more information: www.mirakl.com . Mirakl in Numbers: 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions Our Values: Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique. Our 5 values guide how we collaborate: 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success 🏆 Get Things Done: We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results 🚀 Go Above & Beyond: We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success 1. The Team You'll Join You'll be part of our Fulfillment Product team. The current squad consists of 7 people based in Paris and Bordeaux. Together, you'll be shaping and delivering the core fulfillment experience for Mirakl's marketplace platform — from order routing to last-mile delivery innovation. This role is a fixed-term position for 12 months (open to freelance), which requires to be based 4 days a week in our Paris or Bordeaux Office. 2. Your Impact Own the roadmap and backlog for the Order & Dropship pillar end-to-end: prioritize ruthlessly, groom one quarter ahead, and maintain a clear 6-month roadmap with a 12-month innovation horizon ; Lead the Dropship replatforming of strategic US accounts delivering key capabilities including Shipping Labels (paid feature) and SCAC Codes as foundational infrastructure for carrier tracking ; Drive the Delivery Experience roadmap : automating workflows, improving shipment visibility, unlocking access to competitive carrier rates, and delivering warehouse-level delivery promise features ; Collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing to capture market signals, align on priorities, and bring new features successfully to market ; Actively contribute to Mirakl's PM community by championing AI-powered methods and tools ; 3. What you'll bring to the role Experience: 6–9 years of experience in product management, with full autonomy on roadmap, backlog, prioritization, and stakeholder management Proven track record in order management, e-commerce, or marketplace environments Experience in fulfillment, logistics, or dropship is a strong plus Background in B2B SaaS is a plus Skills: Ability to make tough prioritization calls and say no when needed Strong product vision with a genuine drive to innovate on your scope Hands-on approach to AI: not just curious, but eager to ship AI-powered solutions in production Excellent communication skills to align diverse stakeholders across technical and business functions Fluency in French and English to operate effectively across global teams 4. Tech Stack Experience with: Jira – sprint and backlog management ProductBoard – roadmap and prioritization AI Tools 5. Languages French: fluent English: fluent 6.
